title: chaerophyllum hirsutum subsp. villarsii
intro: Chaerophyllum hirsutum subsp. villarsii, commonly known as the Hairy Chervil, is a perennial herb native to the Mediterranean region. The Hairy Chervil has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to help with digestion and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which can help alleviate respiratory issues and soothe digestive discomfort. The bioactive constituents of the Hairy Chervil include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
